name: Sewer Tunnels
description: Brick vaults, slime-slick ledges and a channel of foul water.
palette: wet brick red-brown, algae green, black water, verdigris on old iron
lighting: shafts of grey light from grates above, everything else in damp gloom
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, flat orthographic projection with every object drawn as its top surface and a short soft shadow cast beside it on the floor, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling
ground: slime-slick brick walkways beside a channel of dark standing water
materials: Fantasy city sewers seen from above. Brick tunnels with narrow slime-slick walkways either side of a channel of dark standing water, mortar bleeding white streaks down the brick, rusted iron grates and ladder rungs set into the walls, shafts of grey daylight falling onto the water where the tunnel is open to the sky, drifts of silt and rubble, pale fungus growing in the damp corners, a collapsed section where brick has fallen into the channel, broken crates and bones caught against the stonework.
